# A string whose length is the declared bound + 1 (note.title, bound 32: length 33).

type note
breaks 5.4, point 3.2
expect LengthOverBound test.note.title
offset 0
extent none
requests none
input 00000021 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000 00000000
